comparison.objective: Relocate an extraction hood mounting foot while holding its mouth fixed over a work mark.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual constraint maintenance while sliding and extending a spring-loaded assembly.
comparison.success_condition: Foot moves about 7 cm to its line while mouth displacement stays within an unstated gate. No spec versions are present.
comparison.reason: It tests simultaneous pose preservation and relocation, not iterative tuning and lock verification.
